description: This is a Python script for training a DETR (Detection Transformer) model using detectron2 framework. It defines a custom Trainer class with methods for building evaluators, data loaders, and optimizers, and includes setup and main execution functions.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: Extension of the DefaultTrainer class adapted for DETR, with custom methods for evaluation, data loading, and optimizer setup.

methods.name: build_evaluator
methods.description: Creates an evaluator for a dataset, defaulting to COCOEvaluator.

methods.name: build_train_loader
methods.description: Builds the training data loader, using DetrDatasetMapper if the architecture is 'Detr'.

methods.name: build_optimizer
methods.description: Constructs an optimizer with optional gradient clipping, supporting SGD and AdamW.
